overview: Farm 999 features dramatic farmyard accidents, rural crime investigations, heroic rescues and raging fires from some of the UK's most beautiful but isolated communities. The series gets access to previously unseen CCTV, body cam and mobile phone footage from the incidents alongside the personal accounts of those involved. Each episode brings viewers into the heart of these dramatic events following the challenges faced by emergency services in the air and on land who tend to life and death situations in often remote and inaccessible locations. It also follows police operations and investigations in these areas cracking criminal gangs and clamping down on the perpetrators.
title: Farm 999

overview: Join host Dan Snow as he travels around the world to bring us the stories behind some of the world's most famous treasures of ancient civilizations.
title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Civilizations

overview: Tommy Logan is an expert jewel thief who has just gotten out jail. He is hired by Arturo Taft as a security expert for his hotels around the world. Christy Cooper is his boss, and she doesn't like it one bit.
title: Palace Guard

overview: Four mighty civilisations - Rome, Egypt, Japan's Samurai and the Aztecs. Their legends remain - now priceless artefacts reveal what led them to fall into the echoes of history.
title: Civilisations: Rise and Fall

overview: Six couples compete to win the prize of a lifetime – a five-bedroom B&B in the heart of rural France. Four expert judges decide who gets sent home and who gets to keep the keys.
title: The Great B&B Challenge

overview: The Unlikely Cook with Awkwafina Nora embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey as she explores contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's remarkable legacy. Nora's family ran Lum's, the iconic Cantonese restaurant in Flushing, New York, and the very first in a now thriving Chinatown. But despite growing up in the family business, she can't cook. At all. She could ruin an instant ramen.
title: The Unlikely Cook with Awkwafina

overview: Auctioneer Angus Ashworth is heading to some of Yorkshire's big country houses in a bid to help save and protect some of the country's most incredible houses.
title: Angus Ashworth: Yorkshire Heritage Hero

overview: The most elite freshmen in college football navigate the pressure of fame, expectation, and glory.
title: 5-Star
Wo De Zu Mu Shi Chuan Yue Nu
The Best Sweet Love of Youth

overview: Michael Hayes is a tough but sensitive ex-cop who goes to work in the U.S. Attorney's office in New York City. When his boss is seriously injured in a bombing, Hayes becomes Acting U.S. Attorney, and butts heads with a number of enemies, both inside and outside the law. He also cares for his nephew Daniel and his brother's wife Caitlin, while waiting for his brother Danny to settle into society following a jail stint.
title: Michael Hayes
Gua Fei Ta Yao Ni Tian Gai Ming

overview: Nail technicians from all over Russia will compete for the title of best in their field. Contestants will have to demonstrate their skills and expertise to impress clients and the celebrity judges with their unique designs and meticulous work.
title: На ногтях

overview: A humorous show for those who appreciate smart humor and want to have a great evening in the company of old friends. On the same stage are legendary bands from the world of KVN, for the first time without judges, scores and competitive tension. There will be no winners or losers, just laughter and the brightest performances from the teams that have already become part of the Club's history.
title: Команды
San Xing Dui Li You Ge Cun

overview: Six celebrities will take part in the longest karaoke night! They'll face off in a friendly – yet ruthless – competition, as at the end of each episode, they'll have to eliminate one another. They know they're coming to sing, but they have no idea about the surprises and twists the host has in store for them! At the end, only one will win the prestigious trophy. Are you ready to party with them?
title: Karaoké Club

overview: Iconic snack foods are transformed in Rewrapped, a new competition series hosted by Joey Fatone. From Twinkies to Goldfish to SpaghettiOs, three competitors use their talents to recreate and innovate America's most beloved snacks. First, the challengers attempt to duplicate the original item from scratch. Then it's onto the second round, where they must use the snack food in a completely original dish. Led by head judge Marc Summers and a panel of expert judges, only one can be crowned the Rewrapped champ!
title: Rewrapped

overview: "The Legacy" is a secret society that began many centuries ago to accumulate knowledge and artifacts to help fight against the evil in the world. This particular Legacy team is set in San Francisco in a castle-like house on Angel Island. Dr. Derek Rayne heads up the team comprised of psychiatrist, Rachel Corrigan; priest, Philip C.; ex-Navy SEAL, Nick Boyle; and researcher/psychic, Alex Moreau.
title: Poltergeist: The Legacy

overview: Private clubs, luxurious couture and charity galas mean everything in this soapy reality series, set in a posh paradise with a wealth of drama.
title: Members Only: Palm Beach

overview: Kirill Shaloy lives and acts in full accordance with his surname, which he was given in the orphanage. This helps him and hinders him at the same time. Kirill joined the police and rose to the position of deputy head of the criminal investigation department of one of the central departments of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. But when his wife, Elizabeth, the first beauty of the department, began to be importunately courted by the head of the department, Crazy, unable to bear the blow to his ego, punched him in the face, for which he was transferred to the service in a residential area, where he headed the operational department. Under the leadership of Shaly, there are several operas, which, for various reasons, are not so easy to organize. And especially for a man like Kirill Shaloy. After all, he's used to being responsible only for himself.
title: Шальной отдел

overview: Brazilian personality Adriane Galisteu relives her love story with F1 driver Ayrton Senna and the controversy she faced following his tragic death.
title: Meu Ayrton, por Adriane Galisteu

overview: Get a backstage pass to a Critical Role episode. You'll be right there at the table immediately after Matt says "Is it Thursday yet?", experiencing the cast's post-show reactions. Share in the tumult of theories, the chaos of questions, and the pitching of plans from the cast after the show. If you've ever wondered what lies just beyond the curtain, this is your chance to find out. Starting with Campaign 3, Episode 83, you'll get instant access to 10 episodes with new episodes dropping every Thursday with each new Critical Role episode.
title: Critical Role Cooldown

overview: The talent show where three new competing sign language artists meet in each episode - but only one makes it to the final. Who will win the hearts of the jury and become this year's Sign star 2025?
title: Sign Star

overview: Anthology series of stand alone episodes about Americans in Paris and the sometimes tragic and sometimes uplifting relationships, trysts and loves they find there.
title: Strangers

overview: The year is 2065 and Noa is given a unique chance to change the life choices he regrets. He travels back to 2025, the week he turned 27, and meets his younger self. A twisted, warm and existentially confused comedy about time paradoxes, decisions, regret, love and the art of coming to terms with oneself.
title: Nya Noa Nyman

overview: The show takes an intense, no-nonsense look at the present-day Los Angeles Police Department's Robbery Homicide Division. Lt. Sam Cole is the driven chief detective of a squad that is dedicated to solving some of the worst crimes the city has to offer.
title: Robbery Homicide Division

overview: Trigger Point follows a group of former Tier One Special Forces Operators who sell their elite skills to the criminal underworld behind the front of a private military contracting firm — and the FBI agent who's hunting for them.
title: Trigger Point

overview: Based on true events, "Yiya" follows the story of Yiya Murano, Argentina's first female serial killer. Set in the 1970s, the mini-series explores her manipulative schemes and the shocking crimes that made her infamous as the Poisoner of Monserrat, blending drama and crime in a tense investigation.
title: Yiya

overview: Rickard Sjöberg hosts the exciting quiz show Deal or No Deal, where one contestant takes on the hunt for one million kronor. The twenty contestants in the studio come from all over the country, they have all won their participation and also represent their postcodes. But only one lucky winner gets the chance to choose from the gold bags and win one million kronor.
title: Deal or No Deal

overview: In this supernatural thriller, the dark mysteries of the quest for immortality unfold along the scorching rural roads of the interior of Goiás.
title: Reencarne
The Rise of the Qin Empire
Thinking of You in the Long Night

overview: Rollie Tyler, a special effects expert, helps his detective friend solve crimes by making criminals see what they want to see. But what is real and what is illusion?
title: F/X: The Series

overview: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!
title: The Palace Gambit

overview: At her husband Jiang Yan's funeral, Fang He discovers a hundred love letters he never sent and finally realizes how deeply she wronged his devotion. Overwhelmed with grief, she is unexpectedly reborn three years into the past. In this new life, she takes the initiative to draw closer to Jiang Yan and tries to mend the rift between them. Yet Jiang Yan greets her sudden change with suspicion and guarded distance. Can the two of them break free from fate and walk through this lifetime hand in hand?
title: Back to Your Love

overview: Mo Xiaoxian, a medicine devotee, sets her sights on Crown Prince Qi Jue who suffers from the rare poison "Bai Guanyin." She barges into the Eastern Palace to treat him, helping him uncover the truth that the Empress Dowager is the one who poisoned him. Resolved to seize the throne, Qi Jue strikes a deal with Mo Xiaoxian: he lets her test her medicines on him in exchange for her curing his poison. Amid the whirlpool of royal political intrigue, the two stand firmly by each other, unmasking a web of conspiracies.
title: Love as a Cure
Da Ye Da Yr Yu You Ai
Ao Bing: A Shadow Puppet's Great Adventure

overview: Stunning series telling the story of 1000 years of monarchy via powerful, pivotal moments.
title: Secrets of the Royals: Births, Marriages and Deaths

overview: Secrets of the Royals is a light-hearted glimpse into the unique world of the British Royal Family from royal traditions and priceless jewels to healthcare, and a look through the keyhole of the grand palaces. The series will feature fun anecdotes from former butlers, chefs, and other royal workers, as well as contributions from historians and royal correspondents, sharing a different side to the royals, one the public rarely gets to see.
title: Secrets of the Royals

overview: Christopher Garplind's life is a burning hell. He has too much on his plate. That's why he goes on six vacations together with as many famous Swedes as he thinks need a little break. Guests include Ulf Brunnberg, Daniela Rathana, David Lagercrantz, Miriam Bryant and Markus Krunegård.
title: Semester Med Garplind

overview: In this series we follow young fishing enthusiasts Elin Seger and Lucas Lövgren as they try to catch as many different species as possible during three fishing trips. Whoever manages to catch the most species wins the Fishing Race through Tornedalen.
title: Fiskeracet Genom Tornedalen

overview: The series revolves around the life and times of Newt Call as he sets out to make his way in the world. Newt participates in some of the major events of the Western era while encountering some of the frontier's legendary figures.
title: Lonesome Dove: The Series

overview: Bill Nylander and Marie Olsson Nylander are facing their biggest renovation challenge ever - an unlikely renovation project in Sicily. They will buy, renovate and transform a 1-euro house into their dream home.
title: Den Italienska Husdrommen

overview: Source Code is a documentary series about how the past few years have changed the games industry and the people working in it. The pandemic, the protests, the war — all of it has impacted game development. Some people lost their jobs, some had to leave their homes, others found in games a way to speak about reality. At the center of the story are developers from Ukraine, Belarus, and Russia, as well as their colleagues from other countries — speaking about work, burnout, relocation, and about how to keep living when the familiar world begins to fall apart.
title: Исходный код

overview: Forensic pathologist Frank van de Goot takes you on a journey through his daily life with death. Driven by curiosity and a passion for his profession, he is always searching for the true cause of death. Through unconventional experiments, he gathers evidence that sheds new light on the cause of death.
title: Doden Liegen Niet

overview: Shakedown is the gripping true story of how a group of ordinary Australians risked it all to expose an unlawful automated debt-recovery system that falsely accused half a million people of welfare fraud. This searing drama is set to reveal how a courageous coalition of victims, activists, journalists, and lawyers fought back against a government and bureaucracy that refused to listen - uncovering what's been described as Australia's greatest miscarriage of justice.
title: Shakedown

overview: Set in Tasmania, the series follows AFL administrator Hugh Shen, dispatched from Melbourne to establish the island's first-ever AFL team. But there's a catch: the locals must build a brand-new stadium and not everyone's happy about the $1.13 billion taxpayer-funded spend. Hugh's mission? Win over a divided public, meet impossible deadlines, placate feisty protesters, and somehow find a coach, players, and a mascot that won't offend anyone. Should be a piece of cake.
title: Ground Up

overview: In Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke, the famous writer, actor and comedian taps back into his curious side and sets out to understand a national obsession he's never quite grasped. Shaun has never understood gambling. He uses cold, hard logic when making decisions and always plays for certainty. But as viewers saw in On The Sauce, even a teetotaller can be swayed - Shaun spent one episode getting drunk to better understand Australia's relationship with alcohol. Now, he turns a sober eye to our love affair with gambling. Travelling across the country, Shaun meets punters, experts, and those affected by the industry to uncover how Australia became the biggest gambling nation in the world. From pokies in suburban pubs to high-stakes sports betting, Going For Broke asks: are we making a risky bet on our future? Can even Shaun's rational mind resist the lure of a "sure thing"?
title: Shaun Micallef's Going For Broke
The Moon Rises Above the Sea

overview: Lu Chengwen unexpectedly finds himself trapped inside a novel, cast as the villain destined for a brutal death. His only strategy is to lie low and survive at all costs. But when the heroines begin awakening to a power that lets them hear his thoughts, the story spirals out of control. In the end, he must join forces with the novel's awakened hero, Gu Zhantian, to challenge the very forces manipulating their fate, and in doing so, discover a path to both redemption and a way home.
title: Born To Be The Villain

overview: After two years spent bounty hunting, womanizing, and drinking away the painful memories of his late wife, Hannah, Newt Call returns to town to find many things have changed. His brother-in-law, Austin, is now an alcoholic sheriff, who has never fully recovered from his beloved sister's death, and blames Call for it. His father-in-law, Josiah, is the town mayor, but hasn't been right in the head since Hannah died. The town is run under the iron fist of Clayton Mosby, who also cannot forget Hannah, who looked amazingly like his late wife, Mary. The Lonesome Dove, the hotel opened by Ida Grayson, now belongs to Amanda Carpenter, a woman with a mysterious past and a determination on par with Clay Mosby's. Curtis Wells also gets a new gunsmith and a mysterious and feisty woman named Mattie Shaw.
title: Lonesome Dove: The Outlaw Years

overview: Once the most powerful princess in the realm, she was betrayed by her beloved tutor and her own imperial brother, and perished in flames. Reborn from the ashes, she now sees her former white moonlight, the revered tutor, bowing at her feet, while the prince of a rival nation serves as her hidden blade. Though the Empress sees her as a destined rival, what she intends to reclaim is far more than the throne! If love was once her chessboard, now power is her game. In the raging tide of love and vengeance, a crown awaits its true sovereign.
title: Phoenix's Homecoming

overview: Betrayed by those she trusted most, Lu Xinnian transforms from a fragile heiress into a formidable warrior goddess. Tearing through labels in a whirlwind of love, betrayal, and power struggles with her lover, she joins forces with the "Sisters of Bloom" to embark on an epic, passion-fueled legend in ancient times!
title: Bloom in Turmoil

overview: On her wedding night, wealthy heiress Liang Yi is disfigured and thrown into the river by her husband Song Zhichu. Unexpectedly rescued, she is forced to take on a new face and live as Xu Yin, a courtesan. "The best mask in this world is another living face." Thus reborn, she uses Xu Yin's identity to get close to gang leader Lin Yun, setting off on her path of revenge.
title: Marry Him in Her Place

overview: Ireland's most extraordinary pets will be showcased in The Big Pet Project - Saturdays on RTÉ One at 5.15pm and streaming now on RTÉ Player. From surfing dogs to painting ponies and goal-scoring turtles, The Big Pet Project is crammed full of the weirdest, wackiest and most talented pets and animals. Pet lovers Demi Oviawe and Adam Beales jump in their Pet Mobile and travel across Ireland to meet the nation's most pet-obsessed people and learn all about their pets. We meet more than 70 animals including axolotls in Belfast, turtles in Tipperary, hawks in Wicklow, pygmy goats in Donegal, a giant millipede in Galway and a massive pig in Dublin! So, if you love pets and animals jump into the chaos because this is the show for you!
title: The Big Pet Project

overview: Charting a Shakespearean fall from grace of epic proportions that left a generation of hurling fans, and an unknown number of victims, reeling.
title: DJ Carey - The Dodger

overview: Neven explores the food and culture of this historic city and prepares some of his own favourite recipes for Christmas.
title: Neven's Christmas in Limerick

overview: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.
title: Arafta

overview: From 30-year boxing veteran Don Lee comes the ultimate survival competition. Ninety boxers, regardless of age, weight, or profession, gather to prove they're the best. They'll face off in explosive matches and missions on an epic scale. Who will survive to the end and be crowned the champion?
title: I am Boxer

overview: OG's hit the road across the USA with packed concerts, camaraderie and chaos.
title: Baddies USA

overview: E.N.G. (Electronic News Gathering) is a show that deals with the personal lives of a group of newscasters in a newsroom at a fictitious Toronto news station. Ann Hildebrandt is the executive producer of the news at station CTLS-TV 10. She is having a secret affair with Jake Antonelli, the young hotshot cameraman. Her world is rocked with the arrival of Mike Fennell, the new News Director who has an eye for ratings. Their opinions clash, but they only have the best interests of the station and their workers in mind.
title: E.N.G.

overview: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win, the latest installment in ESPN's 30 for 30 series, unravels how Berlusconi transformed A.C. Milan into a global powerhouse and used the club's success as a springboard to political dominance. Told over three parts, the film traces his rise from real estate and television to football glory and ultimately to the highest office in Italy. Directed by Sam Blair and produced by Box to Box Films, the documentary captures the interplay of sport, culture and politics at a defining moment in history.
title: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win

overview: The consultants at the country's largest real estate agency reveal the secrets of their success, convinced that a documentary is being made about their incredible work. But the filmmaker has other intentions.
title: Porta premium

overview: Each work differs in tone, style and relationships, but the eight stories, each with a completely different worldview, will be completed as a single omnibus drama.
title: Kiss Kiss Sxx

overview: Full of jaw-dropping twists, this is the extraordinary story of the first murder in Orkney for 25 years as the police suspect a schoolboy of shooting dead a waiter in a restaurant.
title: The Man in the Mask: An Orkney Murder

overview: The Noble tells the story of Chen Que'er, a maid born into servitude, who uses a magnificent gown to defy fate and change her destiny.With her intelligence and courage, she breaks through every obstacle and stirs up a storm that shakes the world.
title: The Noble

overview: Dennis Booker, an ex-cop, is hired by the US office of a large Japanese company to investigate some suspect insurance claims. He is very anti-authority, resents being told what to do, and seems to spend most of his time investigating cases related to his family, friends and colleagues rather than his employers.
title: Booker

overview: Betrayed and cast back in time to 1990, young CEO Zheng Nanfeng finds himself stripped of his title, now managing a dance hall and serving as an aide to his own wife, Zhou Zhiyi. In this era of both innocence and upheaval, he must use his foresight to turn foes into allies and thwart a smuggling ring. More profoundly, through this second chance at life and love beside his formidable wife, he discovers what truly matters. Together, they forge a legendary partnership, standing side-by-side in a tale of strength and redemption.
title: Angry Wind

overview: Shen Qingru's entire family is massacred. Believing Yuwen Que to be responsible, she sets out on a path of revenge. She marries into the General's household, is later confined within the palace, and becomes entangled with Yuwen Que in a tormenting cycle of love and hatred. When the truth finally comes to light, Yuwen Que is willing to sacrifice everything to protect her. The two reconcile, and Shen Qingru is restored to her true identity as the Princess of Cangzhou. Amid fierce power struggles, both ultimately find redemption.
title: The Ultimate Vow, Unknown to You

overview: Hidden deep within a forest of toxic miasma, Baixiao Manor has remained an enigmatic forbidden zone for decades. On the eve of the manor's legendary nocturnal feast, the lord vanishes without a trace. Enter Ye Li, a condemned prisoner who volunteers to investigate, joining forces with Hua Qiankun, a catcher from the Supreme Court. As they step into the heart of the mystery, they unwittingly unravel a conspiracy that threatens to eclipse the very heavens...
title: The Inescapable

overview: It's time to cheer on your new favourite team - United FC. Get to know the squad in the feel-good teen docuseries that will have you kicking every ball and kick-starting crucial conversations across Ireland. The new series is presented by Jordan Conroy, two-time Olympian and Irish Rugby Sevens legend along with footballer, presenter and content creator Vanessa Ogbonna - did we mention she won The Traitors Ireland too?! United FC brings together 15 teenagers from diverse Irish backgrounds for the ultimate team challenge. Part coming-of-age story, part football camp, this thought-provoking series follows these teens as they meet, train and form lasting bonds in the run-up to a soccer tournament. It's not just about goals, it's about identity, resilience, inclusivity and the shared experience of growing up in Ireland today. Everything builds up to a big tournament, and for the big blitz we called in some extra help from Shamrock Rovers and Cape Verde defender Roberto 'Pico' Lopes and Girls in Green legend Áine O'Gorman. What will the pros think of the United FC squad?
title: United FC

overview: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors provides viewers with a unique insight into the lives of Lord and Lady Carnarvon, who manage the estate, and their dedicated staff. The series captures the challenges and triumphs they face in maintaining the historic castle while also preparing for various events and attracting visitors.
title: Highclere: Behind Closed Doors

overview: Gimme Sugar is a reality show that follows Charlene Borja as she attempts to launch LGBT ladies club nights, showing the entire process as she mixes business with pleasure. In the first season, Charlene and four of her friends -- frequent party girls but newbie promoters -- start the Truck Stop in Los Angeles. In season 2, Charlene and Davonee relocate to Miami to start a new event in South Beach, which proves more challenging since the scene caters to a tourist crowd.
title: Gimme Sugar

overview: The Dame Edna Experience is a British television comedy talk-show hosted by Dame Edna Everage (a character played by Australian satirist Barry Humphries). It ran for twelve regular episodes on ITV, plus two Christmas specials from 12 September 1987 – 22 December 1989.
title: The Dame Edna Experience

overview: After a sudden transfer to the department she dreaded most, Hinako hunts for tabloid scoops at a weekly magazine and searches for meaning in her work.
title: The Golden Egg
